name: Small Autocannon
description: The small autocannon: a three-second cycle, a tracking of 160 and an optimal reach of four kilometres. It loads small autocannon rounds. Noldvar Guard starts every calibre line it builds with the small gun.

name: Medium Autocannon
description: The medium autocannon: a 3.6-second cycle, a tracking of 120 and an optimal reach of ten kilometres. It loads medium autocannon rounds, with twice the small gun's damage in every type. Noldvar Guard builds the whole line to one pattern.

name: Large Autocannon
description: The large autocannon: a 4.5-second cycle, a tracking of 90 and an optimal reach of sixteen kilometres. It loads large autocannon rounds, with twice the medium's damage in every type. Noldvar Guard builds nothing larger, and the catalogue ends at this calibre.

name: Small Artillery
description: The small artillery: a nine-second cycle, a tracking of 35 and an optimal reach of twenty kilometres, beyond the largest autocannon's optimal. It loads small artillery shells. Noldvar Guard was founded by artillery officers, and the firm still believes every problem has a calibre.

name: Medium Artillery
description: The medium artillery: a 10.8-second cycle, a tracking of 26 and an optimal reach of fifty kilometres. It loads medium artillery shells. Noldvar Guard gives the medium the most pages of any gun in its catalogue, and the district's fleet offices order it by the crate.

name: Large Artillery
description: The large artillery: a 13.5-second cycle, a tracking of 20 and an optimal reach of eighty kilometres, the longest in the district. It loads large artillery shells. Noldvar Guard builds nothing longer, and no yard in the district has asked for one.

name: Rocket Pod
description: A short-range rocket pod with a 2.5-second cycle and an optimal reach of four kilometres. Its tracking of 220 is the highest of any weapon in the district. It needs no ammunition: the pod feeds from its own magazine and fires a volley of explosive rockets. Noldvar Guard builds it for the hulls that chase fast targets, where the autocannons lose the lock.
